criteria.name: Conversion Accuracy
criteria.description: All temperature conversions calculate correctly (C to F, F to C, C to K, K to C)

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All 4 conversion functions produce correct results with proper formulas

criteria.name: User Interface
criteria.description: Program provides clear menu, accepts user input, and displays formatted output

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Clear menu with numbered options, handles invalid input gracefully, formatted output with units

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Functional menu with minor UI issues

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Basic input/output works but poor formatting or confusing prompts

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Validates menu selection, handles non-numeric temperature input, checks for impossible values (below absolute zero)

criteria.name: Code Organization
criteria.description: Uses functions appropriately with good structure

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Separate functions for each conversion, main function, docstrings, clean organization

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Uses functions but some redundancy or organization issues

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Some functions but mostly monolithic code

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: All code in one block, no functions
